label: OnboardWorkspace
prompt: Use a discreet readiness checklist with readable assigned steps, version context, and attachments. Make each recorded completion and remaining requirement easy to scan; keep employee identity and private onboarding information within their existing authorized views. Keep daisyUI theme and shared shell defaults, canonical permissions/actions, localized labels, complete forms/errors, visible keyboard focus, and responsive stacking. Apply consistently to each styled page content scope; keep page admission and the shared shell unchanged.
